tasks.label: Start Development Servers
args: Write-Host 'Starting Klova Development Servers...' -ForegroundColor Green; Start-Process pwsh -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'cd C:/Mithuranga/klova/backend; Write-Host "Starting Backend Server..." -ForegroundColor Blue; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Start-Sleep 2; Start-Process pwsh -ArgumentList '-NoExit', '-Command', 'cd C:/Mithuranga/klova/frontend; Write-Host "Starting Frontend Server..." -ForegroundColor Cyan; npm run dev' -WindowStyle Normal; Write-Host 'Both servers are starting in separate windows!' -ForegroundColor Green
